simple.meaning: נִיחוֹחַ (nîychôwach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “pleasure.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 6:10. Its contexts include family line, offering, sacrifice, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִיחוֹחַ (H5208).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נִיחוֹחַ (nîychôwach) / H5208 is traced through Ezra 6:10, Daniel 2:46 as a generated source-based concept entry.
